char-4blaze.d: A commander of ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom who seizes NULL's Overworld capital in a surprise attack and presses Shelldon for Turtle Master potions. Spoke retakes the capital with wardens and NULL reinforcements, and Blaze flees into the End.

char-4cvit.d: A redstone expert who runs Redstone Town and builds ender pearl cannons, including JamatoP's escape route and the one to the Far Lands that Wemmbu wants. He sells BAT what he knows about the Director. As mayor of Steampunk City, his orbital arrow cannons wreck Cindercrest's army in the civil war, but Cindercrest captures him, and he is later seen held in Saparata's obsidian prison.

char-1-88-x.d: The first leader of NULL's hunter squad at Spawn, set apart by a redstone-trimmed chestplate. The squad chases Spoke and JumperWho across Spawn until 1 88 x runs into Spoke's arrow railgun and dies, dropping a book of 100 NULL targets.

char-29mxq-a.d: Leader of a weaker NULL hunter squad patrolling the Far Lands. He hunts Spoke, Jumper and Mapicc and captures PlanetLord, then is captured himself and forced to guide them to a NULL staircase, only for Spoke to kill him anyway.

char-underscore.d: A NULL commander. He saves Spoke from execution in JamatoP's Purgatory and, deciding Jamato is no longer the strongest, secretly helps Spoke raise an army and defeat him. As Spoke's second-in-command he eggs on the conquest of the End, captures Parrot and runs the End Prison, but urges Spoke to stop wasting NULL lives chasing Wemmbu through the Far Lands. When ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom attacks NULL, he builds the contraptions that help Spoke retake NULL's Overworld capital.

char-a.d: One of Spoke's NULL commanders, first seen guarding a tower in E154.

char-c.d: One of Spoke's NULL commanders, first seen guarding a tower in E154.

char-d.d: One of Spoke's NULL commanders, first seen guarding a tower in E154.

char-p.d: One of Spoke's NULL commanders, first seen guarding a tower in E154.

char-x.d: One of the four NULL commanders under JamatoP, guarding him in Purgatory and taking Z's mace after Spoke kills Z. Under Spoke, X is the final obstacle of the End Prison's fourth floor, and dies when MinuteTech blows up Parrot's TNT minecart.

char-y.d: One of JamatoP's NULL commanders, with the highest kill count of the four. Y fights beside Jamato against Spoke and Underscore, who switches sides, and dies to Spoke's mace.

char-z.d: The most prominent NULL commander in JamatoP's Purgatory, who executes Vixuality by fall damage. Z is about to execute JumperWho and Mapicc the same way when Spoke drops down and maces Z to death.

char-kenadian.d: A cautious prison-escape expert who, trapped in Proton, gives ParrotX2 the last elytra so he can break out, then escapes through her own stasis chamber. She later moves from the Far Lands Civilization to District 13 and on to the Invisible Mafia.

char-x-6-00.d: The leader of a squad of NULL Hunters sent after Spoke once their predecessor dies to his arrow cannon. They tamper with Mapicc's pearl cannon on JamatoP's orders, so that Spoke will come to Jamato himself.

char-ajthebold.d: Host of the PvP tournament in Merchant City. He sets the rules (three totems each, no elytras or mending) and stacks the Sharpness-versus-Wemmbu matchup; FlameFrags wins.

char-antaggg.d: Leader of the Warriors, who believe power beats skill. He cheats to beat FlameFrags, massacres Canary's people with a warden trap, then loses a fair duel to Flame and his Warriors disband; later he sends what's left of them after Flame in Terminus, then agrees to build redstone defences for Flame's LAW against Cindercrest in exchange for his imprisoned Warriors.

char-apexpoint.d: A loud griefer who calls himself the Ruler of the Amplified and becomes a BAT target. He hounds the invisible Spoke and Mapicc until, during a truce, Spoke drops him into a dripstone trap.

char-arachn1d.d: A power-hungry election candidate who, after losing, builds the huge Kingdom of the Caves, calls himself the true King, and holds Eggchan hostage to force Wemmbu to serve him, using him in the civil war while plotting against his ally Cindercrest. He throws his own people into a deadly Purge to weed out the weak, turns on Wemmbu, and is finally speared to death by yungyx.

char-arcn.d: A drifter through the server's groups: Spoke's team, which Wemmbu and PrinceZam chunk-ban (Parrot frees him, but he won't help free the others), Capital City's mines, the Skyblock and Ice Mountain civilizations, and Egg's civilization, which he betrays because Jaden pays him more than Wemmbu. He later leads pirates who beat Wemmbu in a duel. His fate is unknown.

char-arthurtheknight2.d: Leader of DanchoGold's Merchant City Vanguard, who smuggles Parrot and Theo into Capitol City. While asking Theo to train him, he is maced from behind and killed by ShoeBilly.

char-ashen.d: FlameFrags' pale wolf, the only dog to survive the toxic clan's attack on Flame's base. Ashen fights at Flame's side, is held hostage by T0X1N and rescued, and was the original wolf behind Flame's Orbital Dog Cannon.

char-ashswagg.d: Leader of the Invisible Mafia and, with ClownPierce, the main villain of Season 1. A manipulative schemer who rules through fear, he poses as Spoke's helper, frames him for wrecking the server's farms, and builds an army of invisible players held in line by stasis chambers, destroying civilizations such as the Far Lands. He even helps Wifies fake his death. When Spoke destroys the stasis chambers, he spares Ash, who claims a hidden Director pulled the strings and warns Spoke he will become worse. Much later Ash greets the conquering Spoke, glad his prediction came true.

char-athenaeum724.d: Leader of the Scholars of Unstable, guarding a library of the server's knowledge in the Underworld's citadel. She seems to know everything, and warns Spoke about Wemmbu's orbital strike cannons and a war coming between every force on the server.

char-baablu.d: A Season 2 troublemaker living in End strongholds who helps Fantst try to send an Ender Dragon to Spawn. He joins the Avengers hunting Wemmbu, lands in the LAW's prison, and is broken out by Spoke.

char-baconnwaffles0.d: A player recruited to fight the Invisible Mafia who later joins it instead, after nearly exposing Spoke's infiltration. In Season 2 he steps up to lead Spoke's army after it falls apart, calling himself the Executive, then disappears.

char-beckytronviii.d: iMajesticRose's brother and Quackenstein123's son. After Spoke kills Rose on Mafia orders, guilt drives Spoke to help Becky and his father, building them a wall and moving them to the Amplified.

char-beec4n.d: One of the first members and true believers of Parrot's new civilization, who says Saparata took everything from him. He fights ClownPierce's guards alongside Parrot and is killed in the crossfire of Parrot's own arrow cannon.

char-block-facts.d: A member of Wemmbu's Civilization, seen in the crowd at Wemmbu's speech before the Zam Empire war and not seen again.

char-boomie.d: One of Boosfer's bandits, who escapes Wemmbu and learns that the Invisible Knight is Wemmbu. While Parrot and Theo try to rescue him from prison, Wemmbu kills him with a stab shot to keep the secret.

char-boosfer.d: Leader of the Treasure Hunters, a goofy bandit boss who bullies his own men, runs scams and loses a rigged election in Parrot's End Civilization. He chases Parrot and Theo for Verdaria's treasure, strings FlameFrags along with false promises about Wemmbu, ends up in the Underworld with Wemmbu and keeps the Invisible Knight's secret in exchange for safety. He runs for king on votes won by trickery, then endorses LettuceK.

char-bossstream.d: Chief of the Capitol City Police Force, who turns it against mayor Fymada and plans a purge of new players until Parrot, Theo and Fymada stop him. Later a Cindercrest higher-up under Saparata, he reveals that ClownPierce paid his police to frame Parrot, and fights the Nether Kingdom at Newtopia.

char-branzycraft.d: ClownPierce's good friend and his one weak spot. Parrot's team kidnaps him as leverage against Clown, then trades him back for Wifies.

char-circusmaximus.d: A LAW commander who recruits FlameFrags as an elite member. After LettuceK's fall he reforms the LAW into a force for good, until SargeLAW's Old LAW faction takes it back; his fate is unknown.

char-cloudwatch.d: A friendly Windgrove player who leads FlameFrags and NotSkrilley on a hunt for a lost king's treasure vault. It's a trap: secretly one of the Mist, he planned it to kill overpowered players and avenge his mentor Mistrul, whom Flame killed.

char-clownpierce.d: A deadly, theatrical fighter whose one weak spot is his friend Branzy. Hired by PrinceZam to kill Parrot, he hunts him relentlessly, locks Parrot, Wemmbu and others in his prison Proton, and destroys the server's last trial vaults so no new maces can be made. As Ashswagg's Mafia enforcer he is co-villain of Season 1. Afterwards he crowns himself King of the Nether, sells to both sides of the civil war, and throws Parrot into his mining prison to find his villager. His Nether Kingdom seizes NULL's Overworld capital until Spoke retakes it, then invades the Overworld, overrunning city after city until Cindercrest and Parrot's army drive it back at Newtopia.

char-coinmonke.d: The warden of Capital City's diamond mines, who can't bring himself to kill. Fired by Reddoons after LuigiToan's death, he frees Parrot, Wifies and Dean from the Mafia, escapes to the Far Lands, and later runs a nautilus shop.

char-conexion.d: Known as Sharpness, a tournament fighter who steals Wemmbu's mace Crucible and flees into the Far Lands. He joins the Avengers against Wemmbu and hands the mace to FlameFrags, believing he can duplicate it, but Flame betrays the team and returns it.

char-cookiebunsquat.d: A former BAT spy and leader of a small Far Lands village, captured by NULL. Freed after Purgatory, she founds her own kingdom, keeps her throne against Eggchan's challenge and fights NULL beside Wemmbu, but is captured again after failing to railgun Spoke.

char-corporalpaul.d: Leader of the LAW members who stayed loyal to Parrot rather than SargeLAW. He arrives just in time to save Parrot at Highwater City and dies with his men stalling Cindercrest so 4CVIT can finish the arrow cannons.

char-danchogold.d: Head of Merchant City, to whom Theo owes 100,000 diamonds. He rescues Parrot to protect his debt, but when he tries to kidnap Parrot and Theo to collect, they kidnap him instead and find that his own Vanguard hates him.

char-deanthebean9.d: A clumsy, well-meaning ex-Mafia member who joins Parrot and Wifies. He confesses the Mafia has been finding them through him, rejoins the Mafia to secretly win back Parrot's trust, and dies in the void when Parrot unknowingly pops his totem.

char-deputy-ace.d: LettuceK's right-hand man in the LAW, loyal but troubled by Lettuce's idea of justice: he opposes using the orbital cannon on the Great Sea, executing Wemmbu and killing Parrot. He hesitates to fire the LAW's cannon, then turns on the LAW to free Parrot and Theo and is killed by SargeLAW while holding off his old comrades. Lettuce later admits that this betrayal cost him the throne.

char-derapchu.d: A clumsy, insecure but loyal player, always on JumperWho's side. He guards one of Spoke's Wonders and his End base, is chunk-banned and freed by Parrot, then joins Parrot's prison breaks and is locked in ClownPierce's prison Proton. In Season 2 he joins the Bounty Assassin Team, where Leow0ok scolds him constantly, but he saves Parrot from the Director's assassin MrCube6 and helps hunt the Director. The Director traps him with Jumper and later forces him to guard Paragon, and drops out of sight after it falls, until he turns up in the crowd at LettuceK's emergency meeting and fights the LAW in the final battle against it.

char-descentofangel.d: A royal of Arachn1d's Kingdom of the Caves, seen at its raids and meetings, fighting Wemmbu during the Purge and FlameFrags in E140.

char-devmcchamp.d: A kind member of ItsAli's refugee rebels. Captured by NULL and sent to Purgatory, he covers for Spoke and tries to escape with him, but they're caught and Dev is executed, which turns Ali against Spoke.

char-dingus.d: TheobaldTheBird's beloved donkey, which Theo first mistook for a horse. Dingus is taken by the Capitol City Police, later kidnapped by Cindercrest, and ends up ridden by ShoeBilly, whom he reportedly dislikes.

char-dione4k.d: A rocket maker who mass-produces fireworks for Egg's civilization and keeps at it on his own. Wemmbu later forces him to work for Arachn1d's Kingdom, and in the Purge he teams up with InfamousJJ for revenge on Wemmbu.

char-dizzyu.d: A former Capital City miner who later leads bandits hired by the Wraith to kill Wemmbu and Eggchan. Wemmbu wipes out his men and Dizzy surrenders, then escapes when the Wraith shows up.

char-dol9hin.d: A Zam Empire guard who is later trapped in ClownPierce's prison, joins Parrot's End Civilization for safety, and ends up mining in Capital City.

char-doomedslayer64.d: One of ClownPierce's Nether guards. Killed fighting FlameFrags in E076, they reappear at Clown's side in E151 without explanation, the only player known to return after being killed and banned.

char-dragonmc.d: A player Parrot and Theo save at spawn at Puqi's request. He repays them with tips on hidden treasures, and later lets King Parrot choose a horse to carry him through his reign.

char-drmae.d: A prisoner in ClownPierce's Nether mining prison who joins SnowLicker's escape group and then Parrot's plans. Trying to buy her freedom with ancient debris, she is instead executed by being dropped into the Underworld.

char-dukevael.d: Owner of the Vael Company, which supplies End items to the server. He sells Parrot's mending books, then betrays him to ClownPierce; secretly working with JumperWho against Spoke, he dies when NULL destroys his base.

char-dumbisdumb.d: A Skyblock Civilization member and later a Warriors Council member in the Far Lands, banished from the council after Parrot beats him in a duel for his seat.

char-dylpickleyt.d: An eager wannabe who fails to get trained by ItzRealMe, then leads three Pickle Armies and the Far Lands town of Pickletopia. He helps Spoke and Mapicc until he's captured and forced by JamatoP to try to kill Spoke.

char-eggchan.d: Wemmbu's best friend, laid-back sidekick and usually the brains of the pair, a pacifist who comes to accept that sometimes death is the answer. He helps build Wemmbu's civilizations, is forced into the Invisible Mafia after escaping ClownPierce's prison, and lives in the End with MinuteTech while Wemmbu plays the Invisible Knight. He is captured again and again, most famously by Arachn1d, who holds him hostage to make Wemmbu serve the Kingdom of the Caves until Wemmbu frees him. He then refuses Spoke's offers to join NULL and follows Wemmbu through the war against it, into the Underworld.

char-emberrat.d: A Nether Kingdom commander on the front lines of ClownPierce's army at the battle for Newtopia, who retreats with the rest of the Nether forces when the Overworld holds.

char-epaxialfx.d: A Warriors District member of the Far Lands Civilization, later knocked out of a PvP tournament by Wemmbu and seen at the emergency meeting at the Northern Council.

char-f1nlo.d: A Capital City miner, once called Finiahn, who with R4trick guides Parrot and Wifies across Mafia land, then abandons them. The pair join District 13, then defect to the Mafia; later he farms and runs for King, losing.

char-falconu.d: A player who turns up everywhere: attacking Wemmbu's Civilization, guarding Proton, mining in Capital City, and as the LAW's second-in-command until he quits over its beliefs. He then befriends FlameFrags, exposes Antaggg's cheating and helps defend Canary.

char-fantst.d: A Season 1 Wonder guard turned Spoke teammate who keeps getting chunk banned, once by choice. In Season 2 he turns on Wemmbu, blowing up the Ice Mountain Civilization, plotting with Baablu to send ender dragons at Spawn, and joining the hunt for him.

char-ferremc.d: ClownPierce's closest ally and the Invisible Mafia's top diamond-tier member. He helps Clown burn ManePear's treehouse, threatens Eggchan, buys his life from Wemmbu with a mace, and later becomes Clown's second in command in the Nether Kingdom, leading its invasion of the Overworld.

char-fieldsofelysium.d: Ruler of the Wheat Kingdom, who insists on giving Wemmbu bread. After Wemmbu chases off yungyx's group and brings him a lost mace, he rewards him with horses.

char-firestar2008.d: A nervous First Generation Player from the Far Lands' City of Gods who once begged Wemmbu for mace lessons. He fights Wemmbu, later helps him against NULL, and stays behind to hold NULL off so Wemmbu and Eggchan can escape, his fate unknown.

char-flamefrags.d: A proud sword fighter called the Immortal Demon, Wemmbu's rival for strongest player, who scorns maces as dishonourable. A Zam Empire guard and Mafia diamond member in Season 1, he joins Jaden's Avengers against Wemmbu, then betrays them. Exiled and hunted by the LAW, he and Wemmbu beat a thousand Lawmen and Flame wins their duel, which costs him his friendship with Lomedy until he apologizes. Later he kills the Mist's leader Mistrul, joins Cindercrest for Lomedy's sake, turns on it in the civil war and defeats the cheating warrior Antag. After escaping Cindercrest's prison Terminus, he leads the LAW to victory over Cindercrest, frees NotSkrilley, and hands the LAW to Morr0w.

char-flowtives.d: A skilled fighter who poses as FlameFrags' ally but secretly works for Mistrul's Mist, luring Flame into ambushes and claiming he killed Lomedy. Spared by Flame, he hunts Wemmbu's bounty, then is hired against Flame in Terminus but ends up allying with him.

char-fluffalssupreme.d: A Mist member who alone sees through FlameFrags' infiltration, since a friend of his died in the 1000-player battle. Stuck as Flame's partner, he tries to expose and trap him, but loses a trial by combat.

char-found2.d: A Treebo Village member turned Purgatory's richest black-market dealer, with shulkers full of TNT. She offers Spoke TNT for help escaping, later slips him supplies in prison, and is assassinated on JamatoP's orders.

char-fwendlys.d: A former Invisible Mafia ender pearl courier who runs for King and loses after a rival calls out his Mafia past. Later he trains at District 13 and is seen in Cindercrest's attack on Steampunk City.

char-fymada.d: A Capitol City citizen whose taxes Parrot and Theo secretly pay. She runs for queen, fights the LAW with District 13, and becomes Mayor of Capitol City under King Parrot. Jailed when Saparata wins the Civil War, she is freed by Parrot months later to evacuate the city as the Nether Kingdom invades.

char-geegeegamer.d: A mic-less First Generation Player in the Far Lands who loves building and guides Wemmbu and Eggchan through his old-style city. It's a trap: he shoots Eggchan through an End portal, and Wemmbu maces him to death.

char-george-junior.d: Spoke's pet salmon in a bucket, really a whole shulker of replaceable fish since Spoke keeps killing them by accident. Spoke carries one as his Mafia identifier, earning the codename Fish Bucket; JamatoP presumably burns the last of them, and Spoke later adopts a new immortal salmon, Raphael.

char-gunter.d: A comic-relief LAW soldier in FlameFrags' squad who always starts by saying his name. He ignores Flame's order to retreat and is killed by Arachn1d's forces defending a LAW base.

char-hannahxxrose.d: Leader of the Sleepy Nation. When Spoke warns them about the Mafia, the Nation reveals it is part of the Mafia and turns on him; Spoke gets revenge by sending an army against them.

char-helios.d: FlameFrags' maxed-out horse, won by helping Lomedy win the Great Farm War, and the series' most-featured pet. In Terminus, LettuceK brings Helios out and ShoeBilly kills him with a mace to pressure Flame into joining Cindercrest.

char-herobanenair.d: Referee of the Eight-fold game who later leads the Phantoms bandits in a failed raid on Treebo Village, ending as its only survivor.

char-hey-b1o.d: Parrot's cheerful neighbor in ClownPierce's prison city, the best motivator around, who helps Parrot recruit prisoners. After falling into the Underworld with them, he is killed by TheOathBinder after opening the door back to the Overworld.

char-homunculus1031.d: A member of Fantst's team at the Ice Mountain who catches Wemmbu and Loppezz. He fights Wemmbu alongside Fantst and is killed by Wemmbu without a mace.

char-horace-altman.d: The server's master builder, whose work includes Wemmbu's Civilization, Parrot's End Civilization, Capital City, District 13 and Eggchan's tower, and who founded and led the Far Lands Civilization. Tired of the Mafia destroying his builds and of Parrot's broken promise that the Far Lands were safe, he leaves District 13 for the Invisible Mafia. In Season 2 he runs for king, befriends Parrot and Fymada during the Purge and fights the LAW. Under King Parrot he builds a castle at Spawn for new players, later becomes mayor of Newtopia, and rebuilds Parrot's civilization for a hefty fee. His Newtopia becomes the site of the Overworld's winning stand against ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom.

char-hpneybee.d: A Treebo Village member who votes for ParrotX2 in the election for king, and is later seen with another group of players eating potatoes.

char-ihavenom1c.d: A prisoner who talks only through signs and calls himself the biggest bird; despite his name he does have a mic, a secret only Parrot knows. He joins SnowLicker_'s escape group in the Wastelands during the mining prison, until Snowlicker executes him for a treason he didn't commit.

char-im-a-squid-kid.d: A member of the Sleepy Nation who, with Hannahxxrose, leads Spoke and Mapicc to a hidden obsidian room and reveals they belong to the Invisible Mafia. He died off-screen when the Sleepy Nation was destroyed.

char-imajesticrose.d: A sweet, trusting new player building a cabin with her little brother BeckyTronVIII. Spoke kills her in a dripstone trap on the Mafia's orders, the death that starts his slide into madness; she is later revealed to be Quackenstein123's daughter.

char-iqcniq.d: A diamond-level Invisible Mafia member and the original owner of the mace Crucible. He leads a squad to destroy Parrot's beacon, gets trapped in an obsidian box by Wemmbu after a long fight, and is shot dead by ParrotX2.

char-its-dev.d: One of Boosfer's Treasure Hunters with his partner Kierrrr. The pair chase ParrotX2 and Wifies to steal their quest items, and later vote against Boosfer in the End Civilization.

char-itsali.d: Leader of an underground survivor camp hiding from NULL. He shelters Spoke, Jumper and Mapicc and stays behind so they can escape, but once in Purgatory he blames Spoke for his best friend Dev's execution and even works with NULL to get Spoke killed.

char-itzrealme.d: Called the best Minecraft player, a cold, quiet assassin hired by The Director to kill ParrotX2, who escapes him with the Bounty Assassin Team's help. He later trains FlameFrags in PvP, teaching him to enter "the Zone".

char-jaden-man.d: The trident-mace-wielding founder of the Pirates, greedy, sly and deadliest when it rains. He destroys Wemmbu and Eggchan's empire and exiles them to the Great Sea, gets trapped underground by Wemmbu, then forms the Avengers with FlameFrags to kill him and later betrays Flame to the LAW. He befriends the Invisible Knight, not knowing it is Wemmbu, and shelters him from the LAW until he is captured himself. Afterwards he becomes one of Wemmbu's most loyal friends, following him into Arachn1d's caves and the fight against NULL, until the traitor Nitenly kills him.

char-jagle.d: The only survivor of a village ClownPierce massacred while hunting for a clue to the lost kingdom of Verdaria. Trusting ParrotX2's good intentions, he gives him the next clue.

char-jakevc42.d: A quiet, reliable soldier in FlameFrags's Law team who talks only through signs. He saves the team's happy ghast escape and dies trying to retake a Law base from Arachn1d's Kingdom.

char-jamatop.d: Spoke's first friend on the server and the source of his power: Jamato keeps a vault of old, impossible exploits and teaches Spoke to dupe items and build glitched machines inside the Wonders. When Spoke wants to destroy the End portals and play god, Jamato walks away and vanishes. He resurfaces as the secret leader of NULL, which hunts Spoke, captures him and his friends, and imprisons them in Purgatory, Jamato's prison of games and executions. Spoke beats him and takes the Totem of NULL; kept as a prisoner, Jamato builds Spoke's wither cannons, sets MinuteTech on him, and escapes.

char-jepexx.d: An innocent villager trader whom Spoke and Mapicc keep wronging by accident: they burn his books, blow up his base with an orbital strike cannon and invade his trading hall. They come to see him as a friend and later rescue him from raiders.

char-jumperwho.d: A principled spymaster with her own network of spies. She guards Spoke's Wonders, escapes ClownPierce's prison Proton with Parrot and drifts through District 13, the Mafia and BAT. In the hunt for the Director she secretly helps Parrot, until the Director blackmails her into guarding Paragon. She turns on BAT's leader Leow0ok when he throws her spies away and helps Spoke kill him. Captured by NULL with Spoke, she fights beside him in Purgatory, then frees the prisoners he is forcing into his army. Believing Spoke has gone mad, she raises them into an army against both NULL and him. Later she and her spies shelter Parrot's group, warning that Spoke wants to rule the server.

char-kierrrr.d: One of Boosfer's Treasure Hunters with his partner Its_Dev_. The pair chase ParrotX2 and Wifies to steal their quest items, and later vote against Boosfer in the End Civilization.

char-kingskybound.d: The king of Windgrove who sends FlameFrags and NotSkrilley to search for a vault left by the first king. In truth he only poses as king, to protect Cloudwatch's secret identity as Windgrove's real ruler.

char-lakerek.d: The former leader of the First Generation Players, among the oldest players on the server, who has used the Forge. Fighting with orbital strike cannons, he brings Wemmbu down to half a heart in the Far Lands before surrendering and being killed by him.

char-leadercanary.d: The cheerful, war-crying leader of the Civilization of Canary. He takes in FlameFrags and Falconu to defend his kingdom against Antaggg's army, wins the battle with the mace Flame gives him, and helps the two warriors see their own best traits.

char-leow0ok.d: The relentless leader of the Bounty Assassin Team. In Season 1 he helps Parrot against ClownPierce and infiltrates the Mafia with Spoke. Hunting the Director, who killed his best friend Nufuli, he becomes convinced the culprit is Parrot and nearly kills him, then ends up forced to guard Paragon. Later he wages war on Spoke over a burned village and dead spies, throwing away his spies' and borrowed Lawmen's lives until JumperWho and his other friends leave him. He fights for the LAW at the Northern Council and, beaten afterwards, dies in the void when Spoke rigs his stasis chamber.

char-lettucek.d: A goofy pushover in Season 1 who founds the LAW, captures Wemmbu and sets up the election for a king, ruling as interim leader meanwhile. He grows into a calculating tyrant who treats his soldiers as expendable, executes Spepticle, and hunts Wemmbu, FlameFrags and Parrot. Defeated by District 13 at the Northern Council, he asks Flame to change and is imprisoned. Freed by Saparata in a hostage exchange, he is forced to speak for Cindercrest and made its captain and the warden of its prison Terminus, where he lets the escaping Flame go. Once Flame frees him from Cindercrest's hold, he helps the LAW defeat it, then fights ClownPierce's Nether invasion and stands with Saparata and Parrot as Unstable's three kings.

char-lezy.d: A background player seen across the series: a Zam Empire guard, a miner and ticket agent in Capital City, a Warriors District member in the Far Lands, and later a worker for King ParrotX2 at Spawn.

char-linnwyrm.d: Old Man Lynn, a retired adventurer of the Great Sea (actually 22). He gives Wemmbu a spear to fight the Law and sends him a shulker of maxed gear through Eggchan, and Jaden protects him.

char-lomedy.d: FlameFrags's best friend, a peace-loving farmer who keeps sheltering Flame and helping rebuild his bases. Captured by LettuceK as leverage against Flame, he refuses to be broken out of the LAW's prison and ends their friendship over Flame's killing of a thousand Lawmen, then forgives him once Flame apologizes and promises to change. Knocked off a happy ghast in the Mist and believed dead, he turns up alive. Worried about the famine, he joins Cindercrest, dragging Flame along, but after the slaughter of the civil war he leaves to return to his farm and get away from Flame's influence, and ends up hunted by Cindercrest.

char-loppezz.d: A player who blames Wemmbu for abandoning the Skyblock Civilization, then founds the Ice Mountain Civilization, which raiders destroy despite Wemmbu's help. She becomes a LAW prison guard and loses the job when she fails to kill the escaping prisoners, Wemmbu among them.

char-lordsirwessley.d: A skilled fighter Wemmbu finds at a carnival. He agrees to reveal where the Wheat Kingdom hero's mace is hidden if Wemmbu beats his team in a 4v4, loses, and keeps his word.

char-luigitoan.d: A quiet Zam Empire member who helps chunk-ban Spoke and guards his prison. After leaving the empire he is forced to mine in Capital City, where Reddoons rigs a deadly game against him and kills him.

char-luke4472.d: A boastful player who thinks he's the server's best fighter. After FlameFrags rescues him from the Skullhound Bandits, he leads Flame to MinuteTech in the End and keeps him alive with totems, then later warns him that the LAW has banished him.

char-manepear.d: A guard of PrinceZam's Zam Empire turned reluctant mentor. Mane trains Wemmbu and later FlameFrags, his old teammate, and is the server's only spear master, though he tends to vanish or betray people when he gets bored.

char-mapicc.d: Spoke's trusting, easygoing best friend, with firmer limits than Spoke. He helps him destroy duped items and bring down the Invisible Mafia, which captures him. In Season 2 he finds a full-invisibility glitch, then vanishes and turns up in the Far Lands with JamatoP. Believing Jamato over Spoke, he is captured with him and fights as a gladiator in Purgatory before siding with Spoke again. Spoke's ruthlessness drives them apart: Spoke knocks him into the void, and after a truce in the Underworld Mapicc tries to trap Spoke there, is trapped himself instead, and vows to kill him.

char-marlowww.d: A quiet, deadly diamond-tier Mafia member who stays invisible to guard the Tomb of the Mafia, whose rigged stasis chambers would kill every former member if anything were stolen. She slaughters the bandits raiding it but spares Theo and lets ParrotX2 understand her cause.

char-merffinn.d: A member of PrinceZam's Zam Empire in Season 1.

char-minerman.d: The friendly leader of an End village who owns a rare End crystal and a pet sniffer. Spoke arrives disguised with NULL, tricks him into revealing the crystal, then kills his sniffer, kills him and has the village destroyed.

char-minth4ra.d: The head of the Monarch Civilization, wealthy allies of ClownPierce who keep the Worms ignorant so they mine the crater beneath their castles. When Spoke arms the Worms and they kill the monarchs, Minth4ra alone escapes by stasis.

char-minutetech.d: A cautious, skilled loner who quits the Mafia's founding crew, helps Spoke and Mapicc against it and is forced back in as a diamond member. He becomes the End Guardian, sheltering Eggchan and keeping Wemmbu's secret, and fights the LAW with District 13. When Spoke's NULL takes the End he fights back, but is captured and imprisoned there, where he mentors ParrotX2 and gives up his own escape for him.

char-mistrul.d: The ruthless, mace-wielding leader of the Mist who keeps every player from leaving it. Hired by the LAW to kill him, FlameFrags loses to him again and again, until Flame enters "the Zone" and finally kills him.

char-mixiku.d: A bandit and pirate leader who steals BAT's supplies from ParrotX2 and Derapchu, hunts Parrot alongside Boosfer, and later joins the LAW to hunt FlameFrags.

char-morr0w.d: A commander of the rebuilt LAW under SargeLAW, who helps plan the breakout of FlameFrags from the Terminus prison with a wither. He challenges Flame's leadership and despises the Warriors, but comes to respect Flame after Flame saves him, and Flame steps down to make him leader of the LAW.

char-mrcube6.d: A redstone genius working for The Director, who traps ParrotX2 and BAT with ingenious machines and escapes every capture. He even poses as the Director in his armor, until BAT unmasks him and the real Director saves him.

char-mugm.d: One of the server's deadliest players and one of ClownPierce's commanders, helping him and FerreMC try to kill ParrotX2. He is a leading figure in the Nether Kingdom and one of the suspects on BAT's list for the Director.

char-mxsterwu.d: A sign-talking companion living in Lakerek's Far Lands castle to avoid griefers. After Wemmbu kills Lakerek, he says they shouldn't have, and Wemmbu kills him too.

char-n3tm3tr1x.d: Matrix, one of Purgatory's richest prisoners thanks to his black-market piglin, which only gladiators may use. Spoke kills the piglin, and in Jamato's Hunger Games Matrix raises an army against Spoke and Mapicc before losing his whole team.

char-naparizel.d: A loyal player seen in Capital City, the Skyblock Civilization and the Far Lands' Warriors Council, who becomes a leading candidate for king. He dies fighting the assassins LettuceK secretly sends after the candidates, telling ParrotX2 he will make a great king.

char-nezoshoki.d: A background player seen as a Capital City miner, a farmer in the Far Lands Civilization who helps ParrotX2 free the Warriors from the Mafia, and later a member of LettuceK's LAW.

char-nitenly.d: One of the First Generation Players of the Far Lands, who warns Wemmbu away and fights him more than once. He later joins Wemmbu's hunt for the Forge, leaves in frustration, and betrays him, killing Jaden_MAN during NULL's attack.

char-notskrilley.d: A kind explorer trapped in the Mist who helps FlameFrags find Lomedy and becomes one of his closest friends. He talks Flame into hunting Windgrove's lost vault, a trap set by Cloudwatch, and is held in the prison Terminus until Flame and LettuceK rescue him.

char-nufuli.d: Leow0ok's kind right-hand man in the Bounty Assassin Team, who befriends ParrotX2 while fighting the hacker TruOriginal. Tired of trying to be like Leo, he leaves the team, and the Director shoots him dead as he goes.

char-only-a-squid.d: A Season 1 vault guard and one of Spoke's early teammates, who fights Wemmbu and PrinceZam in a trial chamber before the pair track him down and chunk-ban him.

char-orioncat.d: A friendly high-ranking member of the new LAW who helps FlameFrags and Lomedy build a new base, later helps plan Flame's breakout from the Terminus prison with a wither, and serves as one of Flame's commanders in the war against Cindercrest.

char-ouroboroid.d: A secretive, heavily armed member of the Great Sea's Floating Market who secretly supplies slime to a trader. Wemmbu tracks him down and warns him of LettuceK's plan to destroy the Pirates, but Lettuce sneaks into his storage and kills him.

char-outlawandrew.d: The leader of the Stoneface Bandit Clan, whose warrior Ralamus ParrotX2's ReinaDrop beats in moments with an unenchanted trident. Later he agrees to smuggle Parrot's group to Spawn, though Parrot catches him hiding a Cindercrest soldier in the walls.

char-pangi.d: An upbeat, loyal follower of PrinceZam who guards him in the Zam Empire, passes through Wemmbu's and the Skyblock Civilizations, and later gives Wemmbu and Eggchan a barrel of free experience bottles.

char-paramountx.d: The mayor of Highwater City in ParrotX2's kingdom, who is assassinated by Wemmbu while boating home with his bodyguards.

char-parrotx2.d: The strategist among the four protagonists: weak in PvP but clever, selfless and determined to save everyone. When Spoke's scavenger hunt gets his best friend Wifies chunk-banned, Parrot breaks into PrinceZam's prisons, escapes the prison Proton and leads the resistance against the Invisible Mafia, where he believes Wifies dies. He then hunts the Director, who turns out to be Wifies, and escapes his prison Paragon. With Theo he helps bring down LettuceK's LAW and becomes the first King of Unstable, but Saparata's Cindercrest beats him in a civil war and exiles him. Rebuilding far away, he is thrown into ClownPierce's mining prison, fights his way out of the Underworld and escapes Spoke's End prison, refusing to join NULL. He then warns the Overworld of Clown's Nether invasion, helps hold Newtopia against it, and stands with Saparata and LettuceK as Unstable's three kings.

char-pearitx2.d: An obvious impersonator of ParrotX2 who, during the Purge, fools TheobaldTheBird into handing him food and gear, then runs off when the real Parrot arrives.

char-peentar.d: A guard of PrinceZam's Zam Empire, taken hostage by Wemmbu and ManePear and broken out again by the empire.

char-pestopasta2009.d: A nervous new player who co-founds ParrotX2's new civilization after Parrot's exile. Afraid of dying, he finds his courage in the end, sacrificing himself with a TNT minecart to stop Cindercrest soldiers stealing their villager; the tree he planted becomes his grave.

char-pikatm.d: A Capital City miner freed when ParrotX2 and his friends pay his quota with stolen diamonds, later seen in the Far Lands' Warriors District.

char-planetlord.d: One of Spoke and Mapicc's teammates, first a guard of duped-item bases, then an ally against the Invisible Mafia alongside MinuteTech. Much later he leads a group in the Far Lands and helps Spoke and Jumper before being captured by NULL.

char-princetetra.d: A sceptical member of Merchant City's Vanguard who helps drive out its leader DanchoGold and takes over the Vanguard. He joins ParrotX2's army against Cindercrest, nearly blowing Parrot up during the civil war before Parrot talks him down.

char-princezam.d: The paranoid, controlling ruler of the Zam Empire, who hunts Spoke with Wemmbu, chunk-bans her enemies and hires ClownPierce to kill Parrot. She betrays Wemmbu, starting a feud that ends with him destroying her empire, and the two end up trapped together in ClownPierce's prisons. Freed from the LAW by Spoke, she joins him to repay the debt, helps him find Mapicc and hunt Leow0ok, and fights the LAW with District 13.

char-puqi.d: A wealthy player who smuggles wool and clay to ParrotX2 and his friends in Capital City, and later, in Capitol City's black market, sends Parrot and Theo to rescue DragonMC__.

char-purpled.d: The power-hungry leader of the Far Lands' Warriors Council, who betrays ParrotX2 by posing as the Mafia and is voted out in his favor. He later runs for king against Parrot, drops out to endorse LettuceK, and fights for the LAW.

char-pyxii.d: The only survivor of the Invisible Mafia's massacre of the Far Lands' Warriors District. She later turns up in the LAW and runs for king, losing in the first round.

char-quackenstein123.d: The father of iMajesticRose and BeckyTronVIII, secretly a diamond-tier Invisible Mafia member, which Spoke and Mapicc uncover. In exchange for their silence he hands over the locations of the Mafia's stasis chambers, and Spoke later protects his family from Leow0ok.

char-r4trick.d: A former Capital City miner who helps ParrotX2 and Wifies through Mafia territory, then abandons them. He later leaves District 13 for the Mafia after losing faith in Parrot, and accidentally leads TruOriginal to BAT.

char-ralamus.d: The Stoneface Bandits' champion, said to have single-handedly wiped out the Snow Licker Clan. ReinaDrop kills him in a duel almost at once with a dropped dripstone.

char-raphael.d: Spoke's immortal pet salmon, which he finds in a trial room in the Underworld and carries around in a bucket. Spoke shows him around NULL's End civilization and uses him as a distraction while moving NULL's bed.

char-rasplin.d: A gambler in a floating casino in the End who holds the key to the Tomb of the Mafia. He wins every game against ParrotX2, probably by cheating, taking his diamonds and armor, before Marlowww kills him to take the key back.

char-realroyalty.d: A big spender at an auction during Parrot's reign who buys nearly everything, then gets into a bidding war with Parrot over a chicken, losing only when Theo accidentally bids 100,000 diamonds.

char-reddoons.d: The tyrannical mayor of Capital City, allied with the Invisible Mafia, who traps Parrot's crew with impossible diamond quotas and executes LuigiToan in a rigged roulette. Later he hides in secret bases that Spoke raids, taxes Capital City 2.0 at 90%, then disappears.

char-reinadrop.d: One of the ten survivors of Cindercrest's massacre of Skymore, Reina joins Parrot and Theo to avenge her friend Zoe444. Quiet but clever, she runs the arrow cannons that kill much of Cindercrest's army. Captured in the Civil War, she is traded back and vanishes with Theo, then returns to bring the Advanced Civilization to Newtopia, forcing ClownPierce's army to retreat.

char-rejoicin.d: A kind, lonely Proton guard who later guards a spire in the Abandoned Civilization, hiding from a Mafia that no longer exists. He becomes one of the few players Wemmbu truly gets along with and joins his hunt for Jaden_MAN, but dies cornered by wardens.

char-rekrap2.d: Parrot's partner in breaking Wifies out of a chunk-ban prison, freeing Derapchu, Fantst and JumperWho on the way and accidentally freeing Spoke too. Later his base is burned and partly blown up, he is jailed in Proton, and he briefly joins District 13.

char-roshambogames.d: A guard of one of the Wonders and leader of a small civilization. He clashes with Spoke over a vault and hires Wemmbu and Eggchan to blow up Spoke's End base, and Wemmbu later saves him when FlameFrags invades his civilization.

char-salvationism.d: The blunt, fiercely loyal leader of the Capitol City Guard Force under SirPig, who recruits the Invisible Knight (Wemmbu in disguise) and fights off Boosfer's bandits. He joins the hunt for Boosfer and is killed by FlameFrags, the last to fall in the final battle.

char-saparata.d: The leader of Cindercrest, an old player who blames King Parrot for his friends' deaths and wants every new player dead. Cindercrest massacres the new players of Skymore, and Saparata leads it to victory in the Civil War, beating Parrot at Spawn and crowning himself the second King of Unstable. He traps Spawn to kill newcomers, hunts the exiled Parrot, and forces LettuceK into his service as captain and warden of the prison Terminus. Facing NULL, he offers to lift his bounty on Wemmbu if Wemmbu defeats it. When ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom invades, he believes Parrot at last and stands with him and Lettuce as Unstable's three united kings.

char-sargelaw.d: A LAW commander under LettuceK who hunts Wemmbu relentlessly to avenge his brother SargeRaxby, often blowing up his own men with carts. He kills Deputy_Ace, defects in battle, takes over the LAW, and flees Parrot's TNT trap that wipes it out. Rebuilding the LAW, he later hands its leadership to FlameFrags for the war against Cindercrest.

char-sargeraxby.d: SargeLAW's brother, a LAW commander serving as prison warden and PvP trainer, who believes his inmates can reform. Wemmbu kills him during his breakout with PrinceZam, Fantst and Baablu, setting SargeLAW on Wemmbu's trail.

char-serpentbound333.d: Leader of the First Generation Players and their golden City of Gods in the Far Lands. He tricks Wemmbu and strands Eggchan in the End, but later trusts Wemmbu with the Forge's location and logs off while holding back NULL.

char-sharooh.d: A fighter Spoke hires against PrinceZam, who fails to kill Zam and Wemmbu and is chunk banned. Once freed he becomes a miner in Capital City, and later joins the Far Lands Civilization's Warriors District.

char-shelldon.d: Leader of the Turtle Civilization, maker of Turtle Master potions, which NULL massacres after Spoke steals his turtle eggs. Taken captive, he cares for the turtles at Spoke's test site, then guides Spoke to his old stash and is killed in the fight there.

char-shoebilly.d: A ruthless elytra-mace assassin and TheobaldTheBird's former teacher who sides with Cindercrest and the old players. He massacres nearly 1000 new players at Skymore, becomes Theo's archenemy, and fights for Saparata through the Civil War and against NULL. He spares a weakened FlameFrags, then loses a rematch to him, and once Parrot warns him of the Nether invasion, helps the Overworld drive back ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom.

char-sirpig.d: The mayor of Capitol City, who gives Wemmbu information on FlameFrags but threatens him, so Wemmbu nukes the city. He later runs for king and loses, is replaced by Fymada, works for Merchant City, and vanishes after JumperWho kidnaps him.

char-sky.d: A happy ghast that Parrot rehydrates to rescue JumperWho and Derapchu, later carrying vault treasure for him and Theo. Wemmbu kills Sky with a mace to stop their escape, one of Parrot's main reasons for wanting revenge on him.

char-slicee.d: A miner of the Worms, kept ignorant by the Monarchs who rule them, who distrusts "magic" items and insists on copper armor. Spoke stirs him to overthrow the Monarchs, NULL crowns him King of the Worms, and his army joins Spoke against ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom.

char-smokebomb.d: A mace-cart fighter who reaches the final of Antaggg's PvP tournament and surrenders to FlameFrags. He becomes Antaggg's enforcer, ambushes Flame's camp, and is finally killed by Flame.

char-snowlicker.d: Leader of the SnowLicker Clan, trapped in ClownPierce's Nether mining prison, who befriends Parrot while secretly informing for Clown, and frames and kills IhaveNoM1c. Forgiven after DrMae's death, he holds off the guards and dies setting off a TNT trap so Parrot can escape.

char-soldier73.d: A Cindercrest soldier Saparata sends to assassinate Parrot. Captured and waterboarded by ReinaDrop, she reveals Cindercrest's plans and is forced to feed them false information.

char-soul-keepers.d: A mysterious group in the Underworld who can build there, open portals into the Far Lands and imprison players trapped below. Wemmbu kills their leader DocDespair8 and several members escaping them; they are allied with JamatoP.

char-spepticle.d: A former member of Wemmbu's Civilization who is jailed with Wemmbu and Eggchan in Proton. Later a high-ranking LAW member, he opposes LettuceK becoming king and is secretly The Owl, the anonymous player helping Parrot, his inspiration, win the crown. He takes the blame for a guard's murder and is executed by LettuceK in Parrot's place.

char-spokeishere.d: A cunning, chaotic schemer. He starts the series abusing old exploits with his friend JamatoP: duping items, hiding glitched machines in the Wonders, and blowing the Wonders up when Wemmbu closes in. With his best friend Mapicc he infiltrates the Invisible Mafia as Fish Bucket and ends it by destroying its stasis chambers. In Season 2 he keeps escaping capture and wages a bloody feud with BAT, killing its leader Leow0ok. Searching for missing players, he learns that Jamato leads NULL and is locked in Jamato's prison, Purgatory. He overthrows Jamato, knocks Mapicc into the void and takes the Totem of NULL, then conquers the End and the Far Lands, drives out Wemmbu, and goes to war with ClownPierce's Nether kingdom.

char-spongs.d: A chaotic, clueless troublemaker who drifts between sides: Jaden_MAN's teammate, a Proton guard, and with Willsion the farm griefer behind the Great Farm War. He later becomes FlameFrags' comic sidekick, joining his LAW team and Cindercrest and moving in with Flame and NotSkrilley.

char-straight.d: Better known as Minemanner, a member of the Skyblock Civilization who chases Wemmbu into handing over his elytra, then betrays the civilization by giving its location to the Invisible Mafia.

char-swight.d: One of the best PvP players around, a cold mercenary hired by the LAW to kill FlameFrags. He unknowingly takes the disguised Flame as his student; when Flame is unmasked they fight to a draw, and Swight lets him go with a warning.

char-t0x1n.d: The self-styled Potion Master, leader of the potion clan FlameFrags fights through alone. Toxin beats Flame and threatens his dog Ashen, but Flame survives being launched into the sky and kills him.

char-teamkalal.d: One of Spoke's team in the war against the Zam Empire, who blows himself up while trying to destroy it with TNT.

char-th3blurpinstein.d: A childish LAW prisoner with a cursed pumpkin stuck on his head, whose unnamed crimes are hinted to be the worst in the prison. He snitches on Wemmbu's escape, later helps Parrot's, and turns up as a prisoner of the Kingdom of the Caves.

char-the-banditking.d: Once the richest Bottom Feeder in Arachn1d's cave kingdom, he lends Wemmbu and Jaden_MAN his enchanting table and tends bar at Weave's Drop. In the Purge he hunts them and betrays their plans to FlameFrags and Arachn1d, and ends up caged forever under the Thorns curse.

char-the-codmaster14.d: A timid Bottom Feeder in the Kingdom of the Caves, earlier FlameFrags' guide in the search for Luke4472, who helps Wemmbu and Jaden_MAN and survives Arachn1d's Purge with them. He settles in Highwater City with Jaden, still waiting for him, unaware he has died.

char-the-oroboros.d: A LAW commander under LettuceK and a crossbow expert whose tipped arrows trouble Wemmbu and other melee fighters. He guards the orbital strike cannon at the Great Sea and is killed by TheobaldTheBird in a TNT minecart battle, buried under a sign reading "loser".

char-theg0dofwar.d: A Kratos-like LAW commander who lives to fight strong players. He humiliates FlameFrags in a duel, loses the rematch and is spared, later leaves the LAW, and is killed by an arrow cannon in an unfair fight set up by Antaggg.

char-thelobsterman.d: Leader of Ranger Point, a base in the Great Sea, whose team hunts for treasure and briefly imprisons Parrot, Theo and Boomie. Wemmbu kills him in a duel, exposing his own disguise to Jaden_MAN.

char-theoathbinder.d: A Soul Keeper on a tower in the Underworld who refuses to build Parrot's thousand players a way out, then traps them in his castle and kills about half. He prophesies that only he will leave the Underworld, and later kills hey_b1o at its exit.

char-theobaldthebird.d: Parrot's best friend and loyal bodyguard, a hot-headed master of TNT-minecart combat who insists he is the biggest bird. A Far Lands warrior and District 13 member in Season 1, he duels Wemmbu and helps him against Jaden's pirates, then saves Parrot from withers after Paragon and joins him in Capital City, smuggling players. He kills the LAW commander The_Oroboros and guards Parrot through his reign. After Cindercrest's massacre at Skymore he becomes the archenemy of his old trainer ShoeBilly. He goes missing with ReinaDrop after the Civil War, then rescues Parrot from Cindercrest and fights beside him against ClownPierce's Nether invasion.

char-therealsquiddo.d: A kind, silly builder whose Master Builders build Spoke's Wonders, until PrinceZam chunk bans her over Spoke's duped items. Freed by Parrot, she becomes Ashswagg's closest companion, a non-killing copper trim in the Mafia, and hides with him at Point Nemo until Spoke destroys it.

char-timedeo.d: One of the richest players on the server, a negotiator in the End who keeps a menagerie of mobs and captive players with rare names. He trades Spoke an End crystal for his mace and is the only non-NULL player Spoke lets stay in the End.

char-torrinthetitan.d: A mace-wielding commander of ClownPierce's Nether Kingdom, mocked as Triple T. He nearly kills TheobaldTheBird in a duel until a Cindercrest blimp lets Theo and Parrot escape, then joins the Nether's assaults on Capitol City and Newtopia.

char-treeleaf2021.d: A childish player from the Amplified whose house Spoke saves; he thanks him with the trident Mjolnir. Spoke sends him to deliver a compass to Wemmbu, who kills him for being annoying.

char-trixxio.d: A royal of the Kingdom of the Caves and one of Wemmbu's rivals, who attacks him for banning six of his friends. He guards the crafting table in Arachn1d's Purge and is killed there by Wemmbu and InfamousJJ.

char-trucksandtrains.d: One of Spoke's friends in Quackenstein123's family, with BeckyTronVIII. Spoke keeps them supplied until he has to evacuate the family through a Nether portal.

char-truoriginal.d: A hacker working for the Director, with impossible powers such as flight, shapeshifting and teleporting. Sent after Parrot, he abandons his orders to keep him alive and tries to kill the whole Bounty Assassin Team, until Nufuli kills him with BAT's orbital strike cannon.

char-twirps.d: One of the fighters FlameFrags hires to attack Wemmbu's Civilization; Wemmbu kills him.

char-ven0m.d: A former diamond-trim Mafia member who goes rogue after the Mafia falls, leading bandits who steal and kill to survive. FlameFrags tracks him down and kills him in a duel, and his mace, Incinerator, passes to Lomedy.

char-venthatguy.d: A LAW elytra-and-mace fighter recruited by LettuceK, who repeatedly pops Wemmbu's and FlameFrags' totems in their 2 vs 1000 battle before being the last LAW player to die.

char-vixuality.d: A Purgatory prisoner who befriends Spoke, showing him the black market and the gladiator arena. JamatoP reveals Vix planned an escape without Spoke, and Vix is pushed out of the dome to his death.

char-voidmoon.d: A flippant End resident who makes Spoke win her End crystal at parkour and openly mocks his power. After he razes her village and her castle with wither cannons, she calls him insane and is killed on his orders.

char-wato1876.d: A reserved builder of escape rooms, one of which ClownPierce uses to trap Wemmbu and PrinceZam, where Wato defies Clown to keep them safe. Close to Kenadian, he co-leads the Far Lands' farmers, joins District 13 and then the Invisible Mafia.

char-waylonblade.d: The founder and leader of the Windgrove Resistance, imprisoned in Terminus with FlameFrags. He reveals that Windgrove was secretly a branch of the Mist, explains Cloudwatch's grudge against Flame, and tries to help Flame and NotSkrilley escape.

char-wemmbu.d: A loud, mace-loving fighter, fiercely protective of his best friend Eggchan and forever rivals with FlameFrags. He starts out hunting Spoke for PrinceZam, who betrays him; he takes revenge by destroying her Zam Empire, then fights the Invisible Mafia. Chasing his stolen mace into the Far Lands, he seizes the old players' orbital strike cannons, becoming the strongest player. Bored, he fakes his death to roam as the Invisible Knight, until he is unmasked, hunted by the LAW, and helps destroy it. To save Egg he serves Arachn1d's Kingdom of the Caves, nuking Capitol City in the civil war, then tears the kingdom down. Spoke's NULL then drives him from the End and the Far Lands, his friend Jaden is killed, and he flees into the Underworld.

char-wifies.d: Parrot's calm, brilliant best friend. When Spoke's scavenger hunt demands that one of them be banned, he chunk-bans himself to spare Parrot, and he stands by Parrot through Proton and the war on the Mafia. Then he fakes his death with Ashswagg's help and becomes the Director, a hidden player who sends assassins after Parrot and kills Nufuli, testing Parrot and trying to keep him safe on his own terms. Unmasked, he imprisons Parrot in Paragon and blackmails JumperWho, Leow0ok and Derapchu into guarding it; when Parrot escapes, Wifies dies in its explosion.

char-willerhide.d: A guard in Eggchan and Wemmbu's civilization before Jaden_MAN blows it up, who later joins Spoke's Galactic Empire and is last seen gambling at the Eight-Fold building.

char-willsion.d: Spongs' partner in mischief: a former Zam Empire prison guard who, with Spongs, griefs Lomedy's farm and starts the Great Farm War, ending with FlameFrags destroying their farm. The pair later tag along to Flame and Lomedy's new base.

char-woogiex.d: One of Leow0ok's original team: an End prison guard who helps Leow0ok try to kill ClownPierce and hires Wemmbu to blow up FerreMC's base.

char-wyll.d: A Zam Empire soldier who seizes Mafia City when the Mafia falls and wants to kill Wemmbu for the reputation. He is the invisible netherite assassin hunting Wemmbu, traps him under the void, and keeps losing to him, even alongside FlameFrags.

char-yeah-jaron.d: Ruler of the Skyblock Civilization before the Invisible Mafia takes it over, who gives Wemmbu the mace he names Gambit. Later he scams Spoke and shares secret bases with Reddoons, which Spoke raids and destroys.

char-yungyx.d: A former guard of PrinceZam's who joins Arachn1d's Kingdom of the Caves purely for power. He helps claim Eggchan as a hostage to force Wemmbu into the kingdom's service, resents Wemmbu's rise to second-in-command, and leads its war parties. Thrown into Arachn1d's Purge, he teams up with Wemmbu, Jaden and Eggchan, then spears Arachn1d to death, duels Wemmbu, and becomes King of the Caves.

char-z4ya.d: A gold-trim Mafia member who knows the Far Lands Civilization's location and wants it for himself. Fooled by Parrot's disguise, he follows Parrot into a sculk trap and falls to his death.
